title: Garden Bungalow
summary: Our classic bungalow: a thatched roof, a deep veranda and a courtyard garden of its own, ten minutes' stroll from the sea.
description: Eleven Garden Bungalows sit in quiet clusters along stepping-stone paths. Each has a high thatched ceiling, a king-size bed under a soft mosquito net and a writing desk that looks onto the courtyard.

The bathroom opens to a private outdoor shower and a stone bathtub shaded by frangipani. Floors are cool hand-pressed cement tiles, and the veranda daybed is the best seat in the house for an afternoon rain.

title: Loft Bungalow
summary: A two-level bungalow with a sleeping loft under the thatch and a wide terrace below.
extraInfo: The loft is reached by a steep wooden stair, so it is not suitable for young children.
description: Downstairs you will find a sitting room with a daybed and a shaded terrace. Upstairs, the bed sits under the roof beams with a view across the garden canopy.
Polished timber floors and louvred shutters keep the loft cool and breezy, and the bathroom has a rain shower and a deep tub.

title: Beach Bungalow
summary: A compact bungalow in the seaside garden, with a loft bed that catches the sunrise.
extraInfo: The sleeping loft is reached by a steep wooden stair, so it is not suitable for young children.
description: Set closest to the water, the Beach Bungalow is for guests who want to hear the waves at night. A ground-floor sitting area opens straight onto the lawn.
Climb to the loft and open the shutters at dawn: the sea is a pale line of silver beyond the palms.

title: Courtyard Suite
summary: Our most spacious room: a canopied bed, a working desk and a private plunge courtyard.
description: The Courtyard Suite wraps around a walled garden with its own tiled plunge pool. The bedroom has a canopied bed, a long work table and a daybed for reading.
Large teak doors fold back to join the living space and the courtyard, so the room feels like an open pavilion.

title: Pool Villa
summary: A private villa with its own pool, a broad veranda and a glimpse of the sea through the palms.
description: Tucked behind a high garden wall, the Pool Villa is built around a six-metre pool and a shaded pavilion. The bedroom opens on both sides to catch the sea breeze.
From the veranda you can see a slice of ocean over the treetops, and breakfast can be served poolside on request.

title: Family House
summary: Two bedrooms around a shared courtyard, made for families who want space and quiet.
description: The Family House has two bedrooms, one with a queen bed and one with twin beds, linked by a covered walkway and a lawn where children can play.
Each bedroom has its own bathroom. A small kitchenette makes early snacks and late bottles easy, and our team can arrange cots, high chairs and babysitting.
